notes.title: Demo version coming soon
notes.notes:
We have great news for you !!!

We're putting the finishing touches on a public demo that we want to showcase at the Steam Next Festival in June. It won't be the beginning, i.e. the introduction to the game, but an excerpt from the rest of the gameplay. The player will be trapped in a valley where he will have to survive and then get out. He has to hurry; his daughter is left alone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839665/7d560d2a6cd405028426d7f7b7add9db20754c29.jpg

Cut off from civilisation, the valley hides some secrets, some of which the player will learn. The situation will force him to construct primitive equipment to defend himself, build shelter, hunt and also climb.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839665/1adb89af682dd9081aff1818f339b1e0ec3d2055.jpg

Add the game to your Wishlist and stay in touch with us:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704310/HARM_Weather_Warfare/
